observed_contract: Agent generation persists unresolved mutating child state in subagent-uncertain-tasks.json and uses it to block automatic replay.
The tombstone path is introduced by Agent materialization next to stable conversation state.
Current Core server predates this Agent tombstone mechanism and has no reader/wiring for it.
Therefore rollback from a tombstone-aware Agent generation to current Core can leave the durable tombstone file on disk while making it semantically invisible to the running bridge.
risk: If a child performed or may have performed a mutating local tool and its tombstone is unresolved, rollback below the first tombstone-aware compatibility floor can make the same logical child look retryable and allow duplicate side effects.

offline_probe.current_core_after_rollback: child-A allowed because tombstone is not read
offline_probe.candidate: rollback refused while unresolved tombstone exists unless the target generation contains a tombstone compatibility floor

required_product_contract: Define minimum_safe_agent_rollback_commit at or before the first product generation that can create durable subagent tombstones.
Any rollback target below that floor must be rejected if tombstone state exists or cannot be proven empty.

Prefer a Stage-A compatibility floor in Core/install path that can read the tombstone schema and fail closed before enabling delegated mutating children, even if the older build cannot execute new Agent features.
Include the tombstone file/schema in exact install/upgrade/rollback closure so downgrade safety is checked transactionally rather than by an ad-hoc file existence test.
Regression: unresolved child tombstone -> attempted rollback to pre-floor build -> provider/local child execution count remains 0.

coordination.notion_agent_owner: Do not merely materialize server/account_pool without defining the rollback floor for the newly durable tombstone state.
coordination.notion_core_owner: V27 already establishes a schema-epoch rollback-floor pattern for durable conversation state; extend the same compatibility-floor idea to Agent tombstone state when synchronizing Agent onto Core.

limits: No hosted CI, native Windows, provider traffic, Notion/Codex traffic, production, real accounts, user data or secrets were used.
